units: Exporter scene uses millimetres; viewer fits the board bounds.
notes: Package-family models are visual aids. Y1, U2, U13 and U21 use representative bodies; exposed-pad geometry is not validated by these models. F1 and F2 use a project-formed axial envelope with an assumed lead diameter, bend and standoff. DNP parts, the bare solder jumper, test pads, fiducials and mounting holes have no component bodies.
